blocks.content: You have already learned from the previous chapters that you can create and call a function in the following way:
A function consist of two parts:

items: **Declaration:** the function's name, return type, and parameters (if any)
**Definition:** the body of the function (code to be executed)

blocks.content: For code optimization, it is recommended to separate the declaration and the definition of the function.
You will often see C programs that have function declaration above `main()`, and function definition below `main()`.
This will make the code better organized and easier to read:
